beschreibung:
High Alpine Adventures at the Schlegeisspeicher

The Schlegeis Alpenstrasse winds its way from Ginzling through rocky gorges and alpine switchbacks up to the turquoise-blue Schlegeisspeicher at an altitude of 1,782 meters. Framed by glacier-covered three-thousander peaks of the Zillertaler Alpen, the valley offers a breathtaking high mountain panorama.

Monumental Engineering and Adrenaline Thrills

The engineering centerpiece is the massive, 131-meter-high double-curved arch dam wall. On an interior dam tour, guests discover fascinating insights into hydroelectric power generation within the mountain. Thrill-seekers can take on the via ferrata leading straight up the vertical face of the concrete dam.
